concepts.def: Excludes meat and fish; lacto-ovo includes dairy and eggs.
Excludes all animal products; needs vitamin B12 supplementation.
Excludes wheat, barley, rye; essential for coeliac disease.
Islamic dietary rules; meat from animals slaughtered with prayer; no pork or alcohol.
Jewish dietary rules from Torah; no pork, shellfish; meat and dairy kept apart.
Manages blood glucose; emphasises low-GI carbohydrates, portion control.
